With great power comes great productivity.

Do your best work faster with AI-powered document insights, secure collaboration, and professional content creation — all in one place.

Special Report
Nutrition of Teenage Girls and Women in Humanitarian Crises
Global humanitarian crises have reached unprecedented scale and complexity, with the world now facing the most severe food and nutrition crisis in modern history. In just three years since the start of the COVID-19 pandemic, the number of people in need of humanitarian assistance has surged from 168 million to an alarming 339 million.
By Dr. Heather Esme-Collins MBBS, MRCPCH, MMed

      flex-shrink: 0;
    }

      justify-content: center;
      overflow: hidden;

      width: 13px;
      height: 13px;
      object-fit: contain;

      height: 20px;
      width: auto;
      object-fit: contain;
    }

      font-family: 'Adobe Clean', sans-serif;
      font-weight: 700;
      font-size: 10.23px;
      line-height: 13px;
      white-space: nowrap;
      cursor: pointer;

      align-items: center;
      gap: 4px;

      width: 13px;
      height: 13px;
      object-fit: contain;

      line-height: 17px;

      display: flex;

      gap: 7.31px;
      border-radius: 2.92px;
      padding: 3.65px 5.85px;
      cursor: pointer;
    }
    .fgtui-tool-item:hover {
      background: rgba(255,255,255,0.08);
    }
    .fgtui-tool-icon {
      width: 13px;
      height: 13px;
      background: rgba(255,255,255,0.2);
      border-radius: 2px;
      flex-shrink: 0;

    .fgtui-tool-label {
      font-family: 'Adobe Clean', sans-serif;
      font-size: 10.23px;
      line-height: 13px;
      color: #ebebeb;

      line-height: 13px;
      white-space: nowrap;
      cursor: pointer;
